data.one_liner: A package for creating a customizable progress bar in the console easily.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to create and display customizable terminal progress bars with options for descriptions, percentages, timing, and scaling. Automatically handles terminal width detection with fallbacks and cleans up rendered frames.
use_when: You are developing a CLI utility in Dart
You need to show visual progress for long-running tasks in a console environment
avoid_when: You are building a graphical user interface (GUI) or Flutter mobile app
strengths: Customizable progress bar characters, scale, and width
Built-in support for percentage and timing display
Handles missing terminal width gracefully by falling back to 80 columns
weaknesses: Limited only to console applications, not usable in graphical applications
